implementation: Independent implementation, not copied Linux function bodies. Register/EP0 state facts referenced from board BSP.
upstream_credit: MediaTek / Mentor Graphics MUSB Linux authors; source copyright notices retained in original reference files.
contracts: SET_ADDRESS deferred until STATUSIN completion and DATAEND clear: musb_gadget_ep0.c 774,837-850
FIFO dynamic address in units8 and single-buffer sizes64/512; EP0 reserved64; board RAM8192
USB2 standard requests/descriptors independently implemented; unsupported requests STALL
Explicit parent-authorized board debug VID0e8d/PID20ff, no allocation or production identity claim
Console AU04 v1 op7/8 is original private byte transport; existing userland owns commands and bootwriter
limits: Caller must supply exclusive real PHY/clock/VUSB/device role owner
No IRQ unmask, host VBUS source, disk backend, DMA or raw memory operation
Caller must serialize all APIs and honor all-or-none RX and bounded TX callbacks
